designObjective: Append the evidence-backed Pokémon Championship Series section immediately after the already-approved TCG Pocket section, preserve every previously approved homepage section and the formal phone mockup, and prove the learned rules in a separate fictional fixture.
sourceTruthBoundary: At 1440 the transparent section is 1440x720 with equal 720px fields, copy left and the exact official square image right. At 390 it becomes image-first, then a centered editorial stack. White belongs to the page canvas. The CTA is black by default, gold only on pointer hover, black with outline on keyboard focus, and navigates to the verified Championship URL. The observed mobile src is 1x while currentSrc selected 2x; do not confuse declaration with selected response.

desktop equal split and mobile image-first reflow
formal phone mockup and prior-section regression

transparent section nodes over a white page canvas

proofSurfacePlan.presentationCanvas: Normal user-facing Demo route retains the visible phone chassis, rounded screen and Home Indicator.
proofSurfacePlan.desktopCanvas: Explicit ?proof=desktop renders an independent 1440x900 no-shell content viewport.
proofSurfacePlan.mobileCanvas: Explicit ?proof=mobile renders an independent 390x844 no-shell content viewport.
proofSurfacePlan.inspectorPolicy: Exclude inspector gutters, browser-extension overlays, annotation markers and phone chassis from source-comparison viewport geometry.
proofSurfacePlan.sourceComparison: Freeze default, hover, focus, destination, section boundaries, scroll restoration and computed src/srcset/currentSrc. Compare section-local geometry; never use absolute pageY.
proofSurfacePlan.heldOutChallenge: Create a separate directly reachable, clearly fictional event-program fixture using an original non-Pokémon square visual or CSS-native abstract media. It must reuse transparent-canvas ownership, desktop split/mobile image-first reflow, centered heading-body-single-CTA hierarchy, and the black/gold/focus state machine. It must not reuse the Championship asset, official copy, source screenshot, or the observed responsive reflow alone as proof.

handoff.implementationScope: target section plus isolated held-out fixture only
